name: Reflection Link
source:
Locked inside a facility that erases memory, seven people must recover what they've forgotten to earn their freedom. Explore escape-room puzzles, piece together broken relationships, and uncover the truth behind the sins none of them remember committing in this branching path visual novel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2992510/Reflection_Link/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
七个人被锁在一个抹去记忆的设施内，必须找回他们忘记的东西才能获得自由。在这部分支视觉小说中，探索密室逃脱谜题，拼凑破碎的关系，揭开他们无人记得的罪恶背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2992510/Reflection_Link/]Steam[/url]]
